units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:4">Ḥull. III, 4</cite> <he>אם נטלה הנ׳</he> if the down is lost, contrad. to <cite ref="K00873"><he>כָּנָף</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:18">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:18">IV</cite>), 18 <he>נוֹצָא</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:5">Zeb. VI, 5</cite> <he>והסיר את המוראה ואת הנ׳ וכ׳</he> he must remove the crop and the down-covered skin with the entrails that go along with it; <cite ref="Zevachim 65a:20">ib. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>בנוצתה נוטל את הנ׳ עמה</he> ‘with its plumage’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 1:16">Lev. I, 16</cite>), he must take the plumage that covers it with the crop; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. VIII, Par. 7 <he>יטלנה עם הנ׳</he>; a. fr.—

senses.gloss: cmp. צוֹאָה) maw containing the faeces (= קורקבן). Zeb. l. c. (expl. בנצתה, Lev. l. c.) נוטלה ונוטל וכ׳ he takes it (the crop) and takes the maw with it; Sifra l. c.
